description: This file defines the PlatformCapsData class, which provides methods to retrieve platform capabilities, device information, and perform RPC calls via a nested JsonRpc class. It includes external references to PluginHost interfaces and JSON RPC messaging, and manages platform-specific JSON RPC dispatching.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData
classes.description: Provides platform capability information and RPC communication functionalities.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc
classes.description: Handles JSON RPC communication, including message creation, invocation, and response handling.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData::JsonRpc::JSONRPCDirectLink
classes.description: Represents a direct link for JSON RPC calls, managing message creation, invocation, and response parsing.

methods.name: AddDashExclusionList
methods.description: Adds a list of exclusions related to DASH.

methods.name: GetQuirks
methods.description: Retrieves a list of quirks for the platform.

methods.name: SupportsTrueSD
methods.description: Checks if the platform supports TrueSD.

methods.name: CanMixPCMWithSurround
methods.description: Determines if PCM can be mixed with surround sound.

methods.name: GetFirmwareUpdateDisabled
methods.description: Checks if firmware updates are disabled.

methods.name: GetModel
methods.description: Retrieves device model information via RPC.

methods.name: GetDeviceType
methods.description: Retrieves device type information via RPC.

methods.name: GetHDRCapability
methods.description: Retrieves HDR capability information via RPC.

methods.name: GetX1DeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves X1 device ID via RPC.

methods.name: XCALSessionTokenAvailable
methods.description: Checks if XCAL session token is available via RPC.

methods.name: GetDdeviceMACAddress
methods.description: Retrieves device MAC address via RPC.

methods.name: GetPublicIP
methods.description: Retrieves public IP address via RPC.
